front: Steps of the business planning process
back: Environmental analysis; destiny, cause and calling; objective setting; options generation, evaluation and selection; implementation; review and control.
Where the enterprise wants to be in the long term: its vision.
The need or problem the enterprise exists to address: its mission.
The founders' personal passion and commitment that drive the enterprise.
Specific, measurable, achievable, realistic (relevant) and time-bound.
Studying internal strengths and weaknesses and external opportunities and threats (SWOT).
Comparing actual results with planned results and acting to correct differences.
Tasks, who is responsible, deadlines and resources for implementing the chosen option.
Plan, organise, lead, co-ordinate and control; evaluate at the end.
